description: Reviews an invitation for an executive to speak at an event, says whether it fits the company's priorities and drafts a reply accepting or declining it.

title: Approval Authority Lookup
description: Tells a manager who is allowed to approve a decision, such as spending, hiring or signing a contract, and the limits each level of the company can approve alone.

title: Crisis Communications Guide
description: Guides the leadership team through a crisis such as an outage, a data breach or bad press: who to inform, in what order, and a first statement to send.
